mechanism.claim: During elevated realized variation, a canonical Ultimate Oscillator returning inside its 30/70 envelope combines short-, medium-, and long-horizon buying pressure to identify multi-scale exhaustion beginning to normalize; follow the inward re-entry direction for twenty-four hours.
mechanism.side: long when Ultimate Oscillator crosses strictly above 30 after being at or below 30; short when it crosses strictly below 70 after being at or above 70
mechanism.why_distinct: HVUO combines close-relative buying pressure and true range over fixed 7/14/28 horizons with canonical 4/2/1 weighting. It is multi-scale pressure normalization rather than a single-window stochastic/RSI/CCI, recursive SAR, channel, volume, OI, funding, premium, or Gross9 state logic.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: completed trailing twenty-four-hour realized variation must rank in its causal upper 35%, where multi-horizon pressure exhaustion can distinguish normalization from one-bar noise
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: sparse four-hour multi-scale pressure re-entry clocks are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.source_bar: exact aggregation of 240 coherent BTCUSDT one-minute rows [T-4h,T)
features.buying_pressure: close-min(low,prior completed close) on consecutive valid four-hour bars
features.averages: rolling sums BP divided by rolling sums TR over exactly 7,14,28 consecutive transitions; zero denominator invalid
features.reentry: current oscillator strictly crosses inward through 30 or 70 from immediately prior valid oscillator
features.variation: sqrt(sum squared completed five-minute open-to-close log returns over [T-24h,T)), finite strict positive
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 180 earlier valid decisions, minimum 120, current excluded; rank>=0.65

clock.feature_available: four-hour boundary after completed source bar
clock.entry: exact BTCUSDT open five elapsed minutes later
clock.reservation: global half-open first-eligible reservation; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: canonical Ultimate Oscillator inward re-entry under the requested high-variation regime

stopping_rule: Terminal first failure; no horizon, weight, formula, level, crossing, variation, side, hold, clock, subset, threshold, or control repair.

external_basis.fixed_definition: buying pressure=close-min(low,prior close); true range=max(high,prior close)-min(low,prior close); 7/14/28 rolling BP/TR averages weighted 4/2/1; oscillator=100*weighted average/7; conventional 30/70 re-entry
external_basis.selection_use: published horizons, formulas, weights, levels, and direction only; no incidence or outcomes
